brief: Privorotsky stays constructive while framing the tape as caught between an accelerating AI cycle and a worsening energy and inflation backdrop. On AI, capability is compounding (OpenAI's proposed Navier-Stokes solution, Astra trained across more than 100,000 GPUs) and conference commentary reinforces demand. Google Cloud said $100m+ deals are growing more than 2x QoQ and YoY with AI-server payback under two years. Broadcom said demand exceeds its $115bn FY27 AI revenue outlook, with power and supply the binding constraints. He concedes the bear case is about who captures the economics but argues topline is rising too fast for that to matter. Against this, China August PPI at +3.8% YoY versus +3.6% expected signals the global energy shock bleeding into inflation, and US destruction of five Iranian crude carriers plus Iranian and Houthi retaliation leaves Brent approaching $100, which he says makes a durable risk rally difficult. Yen appreciation on BOJ tightening and repatriation may be diffusing carry leverage out of the system, his tentative explanation for heavy mega cap. Today he watches the first enlarged long end Treasury buyback, at least $4bn committed, and Apple's event under John Ternus. Even on hotter CPI Friday he still thinks the dip gets bought.
